seo.description: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy at our Johnston, IA facility. CBT identifies the thoughts and triggers behind substance use and replaces them with practical coping skills.

hero.headline: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
hero.subhead: Pattern recognition. Our staff utilizes CBT to identify the automatic negative thoughts and environmental triggers that lead to substance use, replacing them with practical, proactive coping mechanisms.

image.alt: A quiet study room at Des Moines Wellness Center used for structured CBT work

sections.heading: What Cognitive Behavioral Therapy involves
body: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy is a structured, practical approach built on a simple observation: thoughts, feelings and behaviour are linked, and the chain from a trigger to a drink or a dose is more predictable than it feels from the inside.

The work is to map that chain, catch the automatic thought partway along, and put a different response in its place. CBT is skills-based and often involves work between sessions, because the point is to use it in the situations where it is actually needed rather than only in the room.

items.title: Structured and goal-directed
items.text: Sessions follow a clear method with defined targets, rather than open-ended conversation.

items.title: Trigger mapping
items.text: You identify the specific people, places, times and internal states that reliably precede use.

items.title: Skills you keep
items.text: The coping strategies developed in CBT are meant to outlast treatment and are reinforced in aftercare.

sections.heading: Where it fits in your care
sections.subheading: Available at these levels of care. Most people move through more than one.

items.title: Residential Inpatient
items.text: Daily structured CBT work as part of the residential clinical schedule.

items.title: Partial Hospitalization (PHP)
items.text: Continued CBT sessions within full-day programming.

items.title: Intensive Outpatient (IOP)
items.text: CBT applied directly to real situations you are meeting back in daily life.

items.title: Outpatient
items.text: Maintenance sessions that reinforce the skills already built.

items.title: Dual Diagnosis
items.text: Used for co-occurring depression and anxiety alongside substance use.

sections.heading: Speak with our clinical team
body: Our intake specialists are available 24/7 for a confidential assessment. We can talk through which therapies fit your situation and verify your insurance on the same call.
